banner.text: In this challenge you will levitate the Feather using the coding wand

steps.openFlyoutCopy: Use an Every 1 second block to run code repeatedly. Open the Control tray
steps.grabBlockCopy: Drag the block onto your code space

steps.bannerCopy: Change "seconds" to "frames" to run the code faster

steps.openFlyoutCopy: Now set the position of the Feather using the Move to block. Open the Feather tray
steps.grabBlockCopy: Drag the block onto your code space

steps.openFlyoutCopy: Set the position of the Feather to the position of the coding wand pointer. Open the Wand tray
steps.grabBlockCopy: Drag the block onto your code space
Drag the block onto your code space

steps.openFlyoutCopy: Finally rotate the Feather to match the rotation of the coding wand. Open the Feather tray
steps.grabBlockCopy: Drag the block onto your code space
Drag the block onto your code space

banner.text: Change Pitch to roll to read the left and right rotating of the coding wand
Try moving your wand and watch as the Feather floats on the screen
